name: Admin Project State Catalog
description: The Administrar estados action opens the shared state-catalog component scoped to projects. It shows the six seeded meanings (En desarrollo, Activo, En evolución, Suspendido, Completado and Dado de baja), contextual help, usage and historical counts, and lets the admin create, describe, rename, recolor, merge or retire reusable states. Create and edit identify required fields and keep validation beside the corresponding control after an attempted action; choosing no merge destination follows the same inline pattern, while permanent seed restrictions remain accessible help instead of a red blocker list. Suspendido is the single reversible-stop state: it stops new billing and reminders while preserving caused debt. Every project remains present in Documents and Communications; the lifecycle effect only groups it into the active or archived catalog without archiving its documents. Editable names and descriptions stay separate from the immutable operational effect and derived consequence help that control and explain billing and closure. A state in use cannot change effect or be retired, and failed catalog writes preserve the local draft so the user can retry. Returning through Volver a proyectos remounts the populated project listing and its page title without a reload at compact, desktop and wide viewports (PA-232).
